title: Fix crash on closed generic structs from referenced assemblies

authorDescription.text: This change fixes the IndexOutOfRangeException that the generator and the analyzer threw for a closed generic struct defined in a referenced assembly (issue 2283). The type collector read DeclaringSyntaxReferences[0] when reporting a diagnostic, and that list is empty for types loaded from metadata. It now uses FirstOrDefault through a new helper, GetPropertyIdentifierLocation, and the MemberNeedsKey diagnostic does the same. Diagnostics whose location is outside the compilation being analysed are dropped, because the assembly that defines the type reports them. I added three tests to GenericsFormatterTests.cs: a closed generic struct, a closed generic record struct and a closed generic struct with an unkeyed member, all taken from a metadata reference. The change touches only TypeCollector.cs and the test file; the README and the analyzer documentation are not edited.
authorDescription.writtenBy: engine lane (Miska), drafted by an isolated Claude Sonnet builder that never saw prompts, pipeline or review output
